an10.76:1.1: [sāvatthi] tayo me bhikkhave dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na tathāgato loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, na tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippeyya.
an10.76:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ, na tathāgato loke uppajjeyya arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, na tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo leke dippeyya.
an10.76:1.5: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave ime tayo dhammā loke saṃvijjanti, tasmā tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho. tasmā tathāgatappavedito dhammavinayo loke dippati.
an10.76:2.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:2.3: rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:3.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:3.3: sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ appahāya vicikicchaṃ appahāya sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:3.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:4.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ, vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:4.3: ayonisomanasikāraṃ appahāya kummaggasevanaṃ appahāya cetaso līnattaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo sakkāya diṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:5.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:5.3: muṭṭhasaccaṃ appahāya asampajaññaṃ appahāya cetaso vikkhepaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:5.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetasolīnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:6.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:6.3: ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ appahāya ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ appahāya upārambhacittaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:6.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:7.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:7.3: uddhaccaṃ appahāya asaṃvaraṃ appahāya dussīlyaṃ appahāya.

an10.76:8.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:8.3: assaddhiyaṃ appahāya avadaññutaṃ appahāya kosajjaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:8.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ. asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:9.1: tayo me bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:9.3: anādariyaṃ appahāya dovacassataṃ appahāya pāpamittataṃ appahāya.
an10.76:9.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:10.1: tayo me bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:10.3: ahirikaṃ appahāya anottappaṃ appahāya pamādaṃ appahāya.
an10.76:10.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme appahāya abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:11.2: so pamatto samāno abhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.3: so pāpamitto samāno abhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.4: so kusīto samāno abhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.5: so dussīlo samāno abhabbo ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ, upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.6: so upārambhacitto samāno abhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ
an10.76:11.7: so vikkhitta citto samāno abhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.8: so līnacitto samāno abhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.9: so vicikiccho samāno abhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ,
an10.76:11.10: so rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya abhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātuṃ.

an10.76:12.3: rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya.

an10.76:15.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso līnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:15.3: muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahāya asampajaññaṃ pahāya cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahāya.

an10.76:16.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:16.3: ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ pahāya ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ pahāya upārambhacittataṃ pahāya.
an10.76:16.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:17.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:17.3: uddhaccaṃ pahāya asaṃvaraṃ pahāya dussīlyaṃ pahāya.

an10.76:18.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:18.3: assaddhiyaṃ pahāya avadaññutaṃ pahāya kosajjaṃ pahāya.
an10.76:18.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:19.1: tayome bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:19.3: anādariyaṃ pahāya dovacassataṃ pahāya pāpamittataṃ pahāya.
an10.76:19.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:20.1: tayo me bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:20.3: ahirikaṃ pahāya anottappaṃ pahāya pamādaṃ pahāya.
an10.76:20.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo dhamme pahāya bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.2: so appamatto samāno bhabbo anādariyaṃ pahātuṃ dovacassataṃ pahātuṃ pāpamittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.3: so kalyāṇamitto samāno bhabbo assaddhiyaṃ pahātuṃ avadaññutaṃ pahātuṃ kosajjaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.4: so āraddhaviriyo samāno bhabbo uddhaccaṃ pahātuṃ asaṃvaraṃ pahātuṃ dussīlyaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.5: so sīlavā samāno bhabbo ariyānamadassanakamyataṃ pahātuṃ ariyadhammassa asotukamyataṃ pahātuṃ upārambhacittataṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.6: so anupārambhacitto samāno bhabbo muṭṭhasaccaṃ pahātuṃ asampajaññaṃ pahātuṃ cetaso vikkhepaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.7: so avikkhittacitto samāno bhabbo ayonisomanasikāraṃ pahātuṃ kummaggasevanaṃ pahātuṃ cetasolīnattaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.8: so alīnacitto samāno bhabbo sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ pahātuṃ vicikicchaṃ pahātuṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.9: so avicikiccho samāno bhabbo rāgaṃ pahātuṃ dosaṃ pahātuṃ mohaṃ pahātuṃ.
an10.76:21.10: so rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya bhabbo jātiṃ pahātuṃ jaraṃ pahātuṃ maraṇaṃ pahātunti.
